# EODHD APIs

> Financial market data REST API covering 150,000+ tickers across 60+ exchanges worldwide. 30+ years of history. Stocks, 20,000+ ETFs, 68,000+ mutual funds, 600+ indices, 1,100+ forex pairs, 2,000+ cryptocurrencies, 117 government bonds, SEC filings, interest rates, credit & sovereign risk, sanctions, commodities, real estate, congressional trades, and more. Real-time WebSocket streaming for US and European stocks, 100+ API endpoints, OpenAPI 3.1 specification, MCP server for AI agents.

EODHD (End of Day Historical Data) is a financial data provider operated by Unicorn Data Services, headquartered in Lyon, France. Founded in 2017, the company delivers financial data APIs. Data is sourced from 100+ providers (including Nasdaq Cloud API, Cboe Europe Equities, ASX, Quotemedia) using VWAP aggregation. Official authorized distributor of Deutsche Borse market data (Xetra Ultra Level 1 and Regional German Exchanges).

Last verified against the live API: 2026-09-28.

## Base URL

```
https://eodhd.com/api
```

## Authentication

Two equivalent ways to pass the API key on every REST endpoint:

```
?api_token=YOUR_API_KEY                 # query parameter
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY      # HTTP header (keeps the key out of URLs and logs)
```

- Register at: https://eodhd.com/register (free plan, no credit card)
- Demo key: `api_token=demo` — works for `AAPL.US`, `MSFT.US`, `TSLA.US`, `VTI.US`, `AMZN.US`, `SWPPX.US`, `EURUSD.FOREX`, `BTC-USD.CC` (and `WTI` on the commodities endpoint). Any other symbol, the Search API, the Screener, macro indicators and bulk endpoints return `403 Forbidden` with the demo key
- Missing or invalid key: HTTP `401 Unauthenticated`. Valid key without entitlement (plan, demo limits, marketplace not subscribed): HTTP `403 Forbidden`
- Not supported: `X-API-Key`, `X-API-Token`, HTTP Basic Auth
- MCP server v2 uses OAuth 2.1 instead of a key (see MCP below)
- Non-secure alternative: `http://nonsecure.eodhd.com/api` (for MATLAB/R)

## Symbol Format

All symbols use `{TICKER}.{EXCHANGE_CODE}`:

| Asset Type | Format | Example |
|---|---|---|
| US Stock | `{TICKER}.US` | `AAPL.US` |
| US Class Shares | `{TICKER}-{CLASS}.US` | `BRK-B.US` |
| European Stock | `{TICKER}.{EXCHANGE}` | `BMW.XETRA`, `BP.LSE` |
| Hong Kong Stock | `{NNNN}.HK` | `0700.HK` (4-digit, leading zeros) |
| Shanghai Stock | `{NNNNNN}.SHG` | `600519.SHG` (6-digit) |
| Shenzhen Stock | `{NNNNNN}.SHE` | `000001.SHE` (6-digit) |
| Canadian Stock | `{TICKER}.TO` | `SHOP.TO` |
| Australian Stock | `{TICKER}.AU` | `BHP.AU` |
| ETF | `{TICKER}.{EXCHANGE}` | `SPY.US`, `VWCE.XETRA` |
| Mutual Fund | `{TICKER}.US` or `.EUFUND` | `SWPPX.US` |
| Forex | `{BASE}{QUOTE}.FOREX` | `EURUSD.FOREX` (NO separator) |
| Crypto | `{CRYPTO}-{QUOTE}.CC` | `BTC-USD.CC` (HYPHEN required) |
| Government Bond | `{CODE}.GBOND` | `US10Y.GBOND` |
| Index | `{CODE}.INDX` | `GSPC.INDX` |
| Money Market | `{CODE}.MONEY` | `EURIBOR3M.MONEY`, `SOFR.MONEY` |

Common mistakes: Forex has NO separator (`EURUSD.FOREX` not `EUR-USD.FOREX`). Crypto uses a HYPHEN (`BTC-USD.CC` not `BTCUSD.CC`). Always uppercase. Always include exchange code. WebSocket uses bare tickers (`AAPL`, `EURUSD`, `BTC-USD`) except European stocks (`GSK.LSE`).

## API Endpoints

### Price Data
- [Historical EOD Prices](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/api-for-historical-data-and-volumes): `GET /eod/{SYMBOL}.{EXCHANGE}` — OHLCV daily/weekly/monthly, 30+ years, 1 API call
- [Intraday Data](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/intraday-historical-data-api): `GET /intraday/{SYMBOL}.{EXCHANGE}` — 1m/5m/1h bars, US 1-min since 2004, `from`/`to` as Unix seconds, 5 API calls
- [Live/Delayed Quotes](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/live-realtime-stocks-api): `GET /real-time/{SYMBOL}.{EXCHANGE}` — 15-20 min delayed, batch via `s=`, 1 API call/ticker
- [US Extended Quotes (Live v2)](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/live-v2-for-us-stocks-extended-quotes-2025): `GET /us-quote-delayed?s=AAPL.US,TSLA.US` — 40+ fields incl. bid/ask/extended hours, 1 API call/ticker
- [Bulk Live OHLCV (US)](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/bulk-for-live-ohlcv-stock-prices-api-us-exchanges-only): `GET /real-time/{SYMBOL}.{EXCHANGE}?ex=US` — All US tickers, 100 API calls
- [WebSocket Real-Time](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/new-real-time-data-api-websockets): `wss://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/ws/{us|us-quote|us-candles|us-status|eu|eu-quote|eu-candles|eu-status|forex|crypto}` — <50ms latency, US + European stocks (trades, quotes, 1-min bars, trading status), forex, crypto; 0 API calls
- [Recent 1-minute bars (REST)](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/new-real-time-data-api-websockets): `GET https://ws.eodhistoricaldata.com/history?market=us&symbol=AAPL` — closed 1-min bars kept by the real-time service, for gap filling (`market` = `us` or `eu`)
- [Bulk EOD Data](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/bulk-api-eod-splits-dividends): `GET /eod-bulk-last-day/{EXCHANGE}` — Entire exchange EOD/splits/dividends, 100 (+1 per symbol with `symbols=`) API calls
- [Historical Market Cap](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/historical-market-capitalization-api): `GET /historical-market-cap/{SYMBOL}.{EXCHANGE}` — Weekly from 2020 (US), 10 API calls
- [US Tick Data](https://eodhd.com/financial-apis/us-stock-market-tick-data-api): `GET /ticks/?s=AAPL&from=UNIX&to=UNIX` — Trade-level, millisecond precision, from 2008, ~80K tickers; trailing slash and `from`/`to` required, 1 API call

## Rate Limits

- Default: 100,000 API calls/day (resets at midnight GMT)
- Free plan: 20 calls/day, past year history only
- Request limit: 1,000 HTTP requests/minute; every response carries `x-ratelimit-limit` and `x-ratelimit-remaining`
- Different endpoints consume 1, 5, 10, 100 or 5,000 calls per request (see per-endpoint notes above and llms-full.txt)
- HTTP 429 = rate limit exceeded, HTTP 402 = daily limit exceeded, HTTP 422 = missing/invalid required parameter
- Marketplace products: separate 100,000 calls/day pool
- WebSocket streaming: 0 API calls, 50 tickers per token by default, 64 concurrent connections

## Subscription Plans

| Plan | Monthly | Annual | Key Features |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | 0 | 0 | 20 calls/day, past year only; EOD, splits, dividends, forex, crypto for any ticker; no fundamentals/intraday |
| EOD Historical Data — All World | 19.99 | 199/yr | 100k calls/day, EOD prices, splits, dividends, delisted data, live (delayed) quotes, 30+ year history |
| EOD+Intraday — All World Extended | 29.99 | 299.90/yr | + Intraday (1m/5m/1h), technicals, screener, WebSocket |
| Fundamentals Data Feed | 59.99 | 599.90/yr | Fundamentals, financial statements, macro, Form 4, ASX corporate actions, credit & sovereign risk, interest rates, real estate |
| All-In-One | 99.99 | 999.90/yr | Everything: prices, fundamentals, news, calendars, WebSocket, SEC filings & analytics, congressional trades, sanctions, tick data |

Prices in USD, also billed in EUR and GBP. Marketplace products (options, ESG, PRAAMS, TradingHours, tick data, logos, index constituents) are separate subscriptions. Extended Fundamentals (bulk fundamentals) is quoted on request. 500 welcome bonus API calls on all paid plans. 50% academic discount available. Commercial/display use requires B2B pricing.

## Quick Examples

```bash

# Company fundamentals (filtered, v1.1)
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/v1.1/fundamentals/AAPL.US?api_token=YOUR_KEY&filter=Highlights,Valuation&fmt=json"

# 14-day RSI
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/technical/AAPL.US?function=rsi&period=14&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Latest news with sentiment
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/news?s=AAPL.US&limit=10&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Stock screener: large-cap tech
curl 'https://eodhd.com/api/screener?filters=[["market_capitalization",">",100000000000],["sector","=","Technology"]]&api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json'

# Bitcoin EOD
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/BTC-USD.CC?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# EUR/USD forex
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/eod/EURUSD.FOREX?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# Search by ISIN
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/search/US0378331005?api_token=YOUR_KEY&fmt=json"

# ID mapping: ISIN to symbol
curl "https://eodhd.com/api/id-mapping?filter[isin]=US0378331005&api_token=YOUR_KEY"

## Response Format

All endpoints support `fmt=json` (recommended) and most classic endpoints support `fmt=csv`. Default varies by endpoint. Newer endpoints (SEC, rates, credit risk, sanctions, commodities, real estate, congress, ASX, exchange details v2) return a `{data, meta, links}` envelope and paginate with `page[limit]`/`page[offset]`; follow `links.next` until it is null. Errors:

```
401  Unauthenticated                      (plain text; missing/invalid key)
403  Forbidden                            (valid key, not entitled)
422  {"errors": {"<field>": ["..."]}}     (missing/invalid parameter)
{"error": "Error message", "code": 404}   (e.g. Symbol not found)
```
